# Wordsmyth

> > Wordsmyth provides educational dictionaries and vocabulary learning resources for children, featuring the WILD (Wordsmyth Illustrated Learner's Dictionary) and Word Explorer products for ages 4-12.

Wordsmyth specializes in age-appropriate educational dictionaries including the WILD dictionary for ages 4-7 and the Word Explorer Children's Dictionary for K-2 students. The platform offers illustrated dictionaries, thesauruses, and concept-based learning materials designed to build vocabulary skills in early childhood education.

## Key Topics

- WILD (Wordsmyth Illustrated Learner's Dictionary)
- Word Explorer Children's Dictionary
- Children's Thesaurus
- Ages 4-7 learning resources
- K-2 education
- Illustrated dictionary
- Early childhood education
- Vocabulary development
- Concept books
- Kid-friendly definitions
- Word exploration tools
- Teacher resources
- Educational platform
- McGraw-Hill partnership
